For the first time in its history, the UAE has sent a delegation to the Winter Olympics - two alpine skiers, neither of Emirati origin.

[At Milano Cortina 2026](https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026), the UAE has been represented by:

* **[Alex Astridge](https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/results/athlete-details/24428)**, born in Great Britain but raised in the UAE and trained at Ski Dubai.
* **[Piera Hudson](https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/results/athlete-details/93634)**, originally from New Zealand, who previously attempted to qualify for the Games under the Kiwi flag before switching sporting nationality.
